siteConfig.title: The Cosmos Ecosystem
siteConfig.tagline: 620+ Songs. 17 Twin Albums. All Levels & Folds Exist Simultaneously.

artists.name: The Crimson Sparks
artists.description: Suki, Soren, Sky, Sol, and Sienna. Spark → Fire → Crash → Ignite → Movement → Wildfire → Embers.
lineup: Suki Moreau (Vocals & Songwriter) — The observer and narrative center.
Soren Crane (Bass & Co-Founder) — The silent mentor who values integrity over corporate deals.
Sky Delacroix (Lead Guitar) — Chaotic creative energy who plays with raw passion.
Sol Kovic (Drums) — Self-taught drummer bringing ska-punk roots and infectious energy.
Sienna Aramaki (Rhythm Guitar & Keys) — Classically trained prodigy seeking authentic creation.
artists.keyQuote: The music was never about us. It was always about what came next.

artists.name: Maya
artists.description: Voice of emotional resonance carrying the legacy guitar. From Preflight to Strings and Theories.
artists.keyQuote: Inheriting the spark and playing it for stadium crowds.

artists.name: That Guy
artists.description: Angry All The Time. Navigating corporate chains, mosquitoes, love, and consequences across Saevit Animo.
albums: Saevit Animo (Act I: Break The Cage, Act II: Real Life, Act III: Love?, Act IV: Consequences!)

artists.name: Pandora Raven
artists.description: Daughter of Time & Fate. The Light Twin raised in darkness who opens what should not be opened.
lineup: Pandora Raven (Vocals, Raven Messenger, Dark & Light Magic)
albums: 7.5 The Spirit of the Raven Twins

artists.name: Elara Dawn
artists.description: The Sun. Unbroken warrior bearing the North Star's light, riding toward the 300,000-year convergence.
lineup: Elara Dawn (Lead Commander, Shield of the South, Light Bearer)
artists.keyQuote: I ride as Elara. Not as War.

artists.name: Solara
artists.description: The Twin-Flame Convergence entity born when both halves become whole at Album 9.

artists.name: The Defective Detective
artists.description: A sharp-eyed kitsune detective working beyond a corrupt system in a noir world where every answer creates more questions.
lineup: Serah (Principal Investigator of Serah Solves; primary musical artist of Level 8 Fold 39)
artists.keyQuote: An investigation produces an answer. The answer creates more questions.

artists.name: Prima & Timo
artists.description: The awakened machine (Core 2) and scavenger boy (Core 1) navigating the Great Cycle, MAR, and Gate 17.
lineup: Prima (Ver. 1.0 CRT Wheels → Primatown Treads → Ver. 7.0 Martial Chassis)
Found Family: Vendo, Ronnie, Toes, Kai, Bernard, Stoney, Sofia, Shelly, Vellum

artists.name: Mary
artists.description: Eighteen, brilliant, stubborn, and endlessly curious—Ridgefall's scholar and certified monster nerd follows every mystery back to the books.
lineup: Mary (Scholar, Library Worker, Singer of Bloodlines)
artists.keyQuote: Every mystery has an answer hidden in a book.

artists.name: Count Wrongula
artists.description: Smug, elegant, theatrical, and irritating by design. His odd-numbered transmissions answer Eve's even-numbered voice across the crossing.
artists.keyQuote: Who, What, Why, Where, When—Wrongula is only one letter away.
